notes.content:
Fixed several crashes, errors, or bugs related to unit deployment, profile options saving, profile layers, camera control (ingame), cell selection, unit deployment, asset loading, Localization, Music and SFX,        and added features from PLAYNYC-based playtesting.

Added the Arsenal View, allowing players to view and toggle between their decks visually, we are also adding a Customization menu in the near future as an addition to this menu.

Added Campaigns to main menu, Stay Tuned!

notes.title: ⚙️ DEV DIARY 04: NEW TRAILER, TUTORIAL MODE // COMING SOON! ⚙️
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’re back with another exciting update as Ferrous: Digital Edition continues to evolve during our Early Access journey. First off—a massive thank you to all of you who supported the launch of Patch 01. The feedback has been overwhelmingly positive, and it’s been incredibly helpful in shaping what comes next.

✅ PATCH 01 RECAP: A Strong First Push
Patch 01 marked a huge step forward in stability, performance, and quality-of-life improvements. Your feedback was clear, detailed, and inspiring—and we're happy to say that many of the most-requested changes are now live. UI fixes, responsiveness improvements, and overall game polish were the focus, and we're thrilled to see that many of you have noticed the difference.

Now, it's time for Patch 02. And this one's a big one.

🎓 NEW FEATURE: TUTORIAL MODE
We know that jumping into a tactics-heavy, mech-strategy experience like Ferrous can be intense—so we're introducing a full Tutorial Mode, available directly from the main menu. This isn't just a short demo—it’s a smart, scenario-driven guide to the core mechanics of Ferrous: movement, action economy, range and terrain, and more.

This new mode is your onboard ramp to mastering the battlefield. See our latest trailer demonstrating it here below:

[previewyoutube=40Zu69_XA4Q;full][/previewyoutube]

📚 DEEPER LORE: RULEBOOK ACCESS & ORIGINAL VIDEO
As part of our continued collaboration with Lewis R. K., the original creator of Ferrous: The Board Game, we’re adding something special for the lore lovers and tabletop tacticians out there:

📖 In-Menu Access to the Original Ferrous Rulebooks

🎥 Lewis’ Original YouTube Game Explanation Video — narrated by Lewis himself!

You’ll find these under the Tutorial section in the main menu. Whether you’re curious about how the tabletop rules compare or just want to hear the creator’s voice walk you through the design, it’s a beautiful touchpoint between digital and analog worlds.

🧱 COMING SOON IN PATCH 02: OBSTACLE & COVER MECHANICS
We’re also wrapping up the final missing core feature from the original Ferrous Beta (Alpha Build)—Obstacles and Entity Cover Mechanics. You asked for it, and it’s coming. Terrain should matter. Line of sight should matter. We agree.

Expect destructible and static obstacles that meaningfully change how you approach combat. Whether you're flanking, taking overwatch, or blocking a line of fire, these additions will deepen tactical decision-making and bring the Ferrous battlefield to life.

🗣️ BUILT WITH YOU
Patch 02 is centered around community feedback and feature requests. You’ve told us what you love, what you’re missing, and where you want us to go. We’re listening—and building Ferrous alongside you, step by step.

Want to get more involved? Join us on [Discord] to shape future builds and gain early insights.

Thank you again for believing in Ferrous. We’re still early, but the momentum is growing—and we can’t wait to show you what’s next.

⚙ Stay tuned. Stay sharp.
— The Ferrous Dev Team

notes.title: Dev Diary 03 -📘 Alpha v5 Ruleset Incoming!
notes.content:
Big update from the rustcore frontlines—

Lewis R. K. has been deep in the field with fellow indie devs, fans, and attendees alike, dissecting and refining the rules of Ferrous. After hands-on play sessions, multiple events attended in Thailand, and a ton of thoughtful feedback, we're nearly ready to drop Alpha v5 of the official rulebook!

At the moment, the game still lives as a boardgame at heart—but the vision? Is to evolve it into a full-on wargame. Tactical. Elaborate. Clear.

Here’s a sneak peek at what’s changing in Alpha v5:

🔫 Ammo Rule Overhaul   – cleaner, and way more dynamic

📖 Better Documentation  – no more guesswork

🎯 Back Attack Rule, Refined – precision matters

🎯 Objective-Based Play – with game modes and reinforcements!

💥 Heavy Autocannon Rebalance – for the fifth time... we’re serious this time 😅

Alpha v3 is still supported in the video game's settings which we intend to expose to player interaction in the coming months, and v4 is the current standard—but v5 is shaping up to be the most streamlined, tactical version yet.

Stay tuned—more details (and a downloadable PDF) coming soon.
– The Ferrous Team

notes.title: Dev Diary 00: Launch and the Path Forward
notes.content:
Hello Pilots,

As of March 6th, 2025, Ferrous Digital Edition has officially launched in Early Access; it’s been a long journey—one that’s still just beginning! Development has been ongoing for about 10 months, and in that time, the main objective had been clear: to bring Lewis R.K.’s Alpha v3 rulebook for the Ferrous board game into a digital format and for sale on digital platforms. This has not always been clear, and I want to take a moment to reflect on the development thus far.

From Tabletop to Digital: The Evolution of Ferrous
One of the most exciting (and challenging) aspects of developing Ferrous Digital Edition has been staying true to the board game’s roots while also expanding its potential in a digital space. During the Alpha there was a lot of discussion about how Ferrous would evolve, how to add the 'user's touch' to their digital Battalion. However, since development began, Lewis has released the Alpha v4 rulebook, which introduces many new features and refinements to the original system we hoped to adapt. Winter largely has been characterized by the push to adapt the v4 rules faithfully.  Thankfully Ferrous Digital Edition, as of Beta, now largely reflects the v4 rulebooks. Some of these additions include:

🔹Fog of War
🔹Battle Skills
🔹Quadrapedal Mechs
🔹Turning being limited to pre or post Move (rather than being a 1AP action)
🔹Custom Rules (Reload Rule, Allow Quads)

For the game we at Sasori Zero Labs want to write a definitive Roadmap of what to expect and hope to deliver this specific announcement before April. This first Roadmap will reflect what to expect for the next year. We intend for Ferrous Digital Edition to be in Early access for 1 & 1/2 years and hope to then write a second Roadmap, largely concerning Full Release and DLC next year.  The game will continue to evolve, integrating new mechanics, refinements, and additional features over time. For user convenience we will be including copies of the v4 Rulebook with the game as well as instructional materials that come with the board game. You may also grab these materials here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1okZUlTibqhEK_sp1gha8RkMx2j5sJNCe


At this time there are no plans to make an adaptation of the v3 rulebook, and the v5 rulebook may come out while the game is in Early Access. Rest assured Team Ferrous will adapt any rulebook changes and make the evolution of the game a fun and easy process. Ferrous Digital Edition is meant to serve as a compliment to the board game while insuring it is even more widely accessible via global digital distribution.

What’s Next?
To keep things focused, the immediate goal(s) are to enhance the game’s visuals, to add full 3d animations to Entity actions, and add Obstacles to the game that serve as a form of cover and hurdles to navigate ingame. Our next major update will introduce:
✅ Expanded VFX & Animations – Bringing more impact to combat, movement, and user interaction.
✅ Smoother Visual Feedback    – Improving responsiveness and immersion.
✅ A New Map                           –  An all new map that features Obstacles of various sizes
✅ Randomized Quickplay AI     –  Quickplay will result in the Opponent using a random deck (Custom 
                                                       game AI will have an optional similar feature also)

Adding Obstacles will complete our adaptation of the v4 rulebook and open the doors to make large scale urban maps similar to Ferrous' Steel Bridge Set. The VFX and Animation updates will lay the groundwork for our first Major Milestone: Mecha and Deck Customization. This system will allow players to personalize their mechs skins as well as set their weapons, offering greater depth and strategic options for players to experiment with. Lastly randomizing the deck the AI uses can further enhance player experience by spicing up the fight against the AI.

Final Thoughts
Ferrous Digital Edition is still in its early days, and everyone's feedback is invaluable in shaping the game’s future. We appreciate your patience, your support, and your enthusiasm. There’s a lot more to come, and Team Ferrous is excited to build Ferrous in public, alongside you.

See you on the battlefield,
Miles J. Litteral, Sasori Zero Labs
